messages:
infra-monitor: [ALERT] High latency + KV cache growth detected for /v1/generate (us-west-2). Rolling KV size from 3GB -> 36GB in 12m on rope shards 12-18. Possible long-context prefetch storm. Trace: https://obs.redwood/trace/abc123

incident-bot: Pager -> @alex (sre-oncall). Incident created in #incidents. Severity: P1. Runbook: https://wiki/redwood/kvcache-runbook

alex: ack — I'm oncall, grabbing graphs now. Any customer-reported errors?

marco: Observability: We see NTK window distribution shift — 95p NTK moved from 4k -> 28k in last hour. YaRN sliding-window prefetch ramped up around 02:10 UTC. Posting heatmap: https://obs.redwood/heat/xyz

priya: eng-runtime here — recent deploy enabled yarn.sliding_window.prefetch=on (canary) and increased continuous_batch.threshold to 0.85. Those together let prefetch fanout blow past eviction rate. Logs (excerpt):
```
rope-worker[12]: prefetch: keys_enqueued=1.2M, kv_store_size_bytes=38643704320
continuous_batcher: avg_batch_tokens=1120, backlog=23
```

alex: so batches growing and kv isn't evicting fast enough. Are we seeing OOMs or GC?

priya: GC spikes but not full OOM; the problem is sustained write pressure to KV and index churn. Suggest immediate mitigation: disable yarn prefetch on affected pools AND lower continuous_batch.max_tokens.

kate: eng-runtime — propose hotfix: set YARN_PREFETCH_ENABLED=false and ROPE_NTK_WINDOW=8192 for canary pool; also set CONT_BATCH_MAXTOK=1024. I'll patch canary now.

ops-bot: rolling update initiated for rope-worker-pool-canary -> command: kubectl -n inference set env deploy/rope-worker YARN_PREFETCH_ENABLED=false ROPE_NTK_WINDOW=8192 CONT_BATCH_MAXTOK=1024

ops-bot: rollout status: 3/3 updated on rope-worker-canary-1..3.

marco: after canary: KV growth plateaued on canary pods, miss rate fell ~70%, p95 latency for /v1/generate down from 1.8s -> 430ms on canary. Graph: https://obs.redwood/canary

alex: OK — looks good. Plan to roll to remaining pools but do it staggered. I'll coordinate.

priya: I'll prepare a hotfix PR to set defaults back to conservative values while we investigate: yarn.sliding_window.prefetch=false by default, continuous_batch.threshold=0.6, continuous_batch.max_tokens=2048.

incident-bot: Severity -> P2 (reduced). Notifying stakeholders and CS.

lia: support-liaison — reached out to 3 affected customers. No data loss; increased latency only. One customer was on a large summarization job (64k context) — they were throttled and we recommended pause/retry.

alex: Rolling to remaining pools now. Commands (staggered 3m windows):
```
for pool in canary pool-a pool-b pool-c; do
  kubectl -n inference set env deploy/rope-worker-${pool} YARN_PREFETCH_ENABLED=false ROPE_NTK_WINDOW=8192 CONT_BATCH_MAXTOK=1024
  sleep 180
done
```

ops-bot: rolling updates in progress for pool-a.

marco: mid-roll: overall KV growth slope reversed; cluster-wide p95 back to ~500ms. Thank you.

priya: Root cause (prelim): combination of enabling YaRN sliding-window prefetch + aggressive NTK scaling for long-context workloads + high continuous-batching thresholds. This allowed prefetch fanout to outpace eviction leading to cache "tsunami". Also a missing circuit-breaker that limits per-request prefetch keys.

kate: Action items logged:
- revert default prefetch enabled flag -> PR #4523 (priya)
- add per-request prefetch limit and guardrail (eng-runtime)
- alarm when KV size > 2x baseline for a shard (sre/obs)
- add canary-run to test longctx + batching combos in perf lab (eng-ml)
- add doc change to release checklist for sliding-window toggles (product)

lia: Customer impact summary sent to CS. No SLA breaches recorded, but degraded latency for ~3 customers for 12-36 minutes.

alex: Summarized timeline for postmortem: 02:06 alert -> 02:10 canary deploy changed config -> 02:22 canary stable -> 02:28 staggered roll -> 02:46 mitigation complete cluster-wide.

priya: I'll run a targeted load test to reproduce fanout and validate guardrails. Will follow up with numbers in the postmortem.

marco: adding note: we should instrument NTK window trim events and surface prefetch queue length per pool in Console.

kate: scheduling postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Assigning owners in the ticket.

alex: thanks team — great quick coordination. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident archived as INC-2026-984 (link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-984). Postmortem assigned to priya.

incident-bot: Reminder: capture all logs and traces before 7 days retention cutoff.

priya: noted. I'll attach perf traces and canary results to the postmortem ticket.

kate: leaving final note — consider defaulting continuous batch thresholds to conservative for all longctx-related ops. :memo:
_meta: generated for dataset: realistic slack incident thread about KV cache blowup caused by long-context rope/YaRN sliding window + continuous batching; includes bot messages, commands, hotfix, customer impact, actions
